name: Aoba Yuu
source:
A normal boy who is a little mature.

Good parent-child relationship, but concerned about mother's unprotected clothing and attitude. Sometimes does household chores to reduce the burden on his mother.

He sometimes masturbates in secret, thinking of his mother. He is friends with Taiki for the first time since he moved to a new school.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc085/]official site[/url]]
